answer: Behavioral Correlation Scoring assigns each identity a persistent history keyed to its transaction graph, then clusters identities whose activity timing and counterparties overlap unusually. A raven of new accounts funded from one source and echoing identical call patterns gets flagged; a single ember of organic activity stays clean. Enforcement: correlated clusters have rewards withheld and are throttled until independently verified. Cost to attacker: each fake identity must sustain months of distinct, non-overlapping behavior, multiplying per-identity effort far beyond registration.
